name: UI：任务管理-详情页分页验证
description: 验证详情页底部有分页组件

steps.expression: (() => { const pagination = document.querySelector('.ant-pagination'); const totalText = document.body.innerText.match(/共\s*\d+\s*条/); return { hasPagination: !!pagination, totalText: totalText?.[0] || null, url: location.href }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在任务管理数据
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 分页显示'共 N 条'
